article.story: San Antonio Spurs (6-2, fourth in the Western Conference) vs. Portland Trail Blazers (6-2, fifth in the Western Conference) Portland, Oregon; Saturday, 10 p.m. EST LINE: Spurs -3.5; over/under is 228.5 BOTTOM LINE: San Antonio visits the Portland Trail Blazers after Victor Wembanyama's 52-point game in the Spurs' 112-111 win over the Dallas Mavericks. Portland went 42-40 overall and 29-23 in Western Conference games a season ago. The Trail Blazers gave up 115.8 points per game while committing 19.9 fouls last season. San Antonio went 62-20 overall and 36-16 in Western Conference play during the 2025-26 season. The Spurs averaged 28.1 assists per game on 43.4 made field goals last season. INJURIES: Trail Blazers: Shaedon Sharpe: out (meniscus), Vit Krejci: out (leg), Ja Morant: out (hamstring). Spurs: Jayden Quaintance: out (knee), Tobias Harris: out (calf). ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
